purpose: Public audit evidence for Bukkit 0.1.1 and explicitly identified historical Bukkit / 1.19.4 development validation.
pathBase: The file field is relative to outputs/. Report-reference paths and licenseEquivalenceReport are relative to the repository root. originalPath records the original local cache location.
versionScope: The 0.1.1- filename prefix groups this publication evidence bundle. It does not change the tested artifact versions or hashes in original records: the bundle includes v0.1.0-test.1 historical Bukkit runs, pre-GPL and GPL 0.1.1 Bukkit runs, and pre-GPL 1.19.4 0.2.0-dev mod runs.

privacyReview.scope: Selected JSON and log files only. Checked structured references and hash semantics, token/private-key patterns, raw hardware-identifier assignment patterns, private user-home paths, player/account patterns, UUIDs and 64-hex values. Known synthetic fixture provenance was compared before copying.
privacyReview.syntheticIdentifiers: Retained deterministic OfflinePlayer UUIDs for the test accounts and SHA-256 fixture device values. These were matched to the test fixtures; loopback addresses and generated management-rule UUIDs are retained.
